## Part 2(a)

```{r load_2a}
delay_summary_hour <- read_csv("data/delay_summary_hour_2004_2008.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
delay_summary_day <- read_csv("data/delay_summary_day_2004_2008.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
best_hour_each_year_filtered <- read_csv("data/best_hour_each_year_filtered.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
best_day_each_year <- read_csv("data/best_day_each_year.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

delay_summary_hour
delay_summary_day
```

```{r check_tables}
best_hour_each_year_filtered
best_day_each_year
```

```{r plot_hourly_2a}
delay_summary_hour_filtered <- delay_summary_hour %>%
  filter(n_flights >= 10000)

p2a_hour_r <- ggplot(delay_summary_hour_filtered, aes(x = sched_dep_hour)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_arr_delay, color = "Mean arrival delay"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_dep_delay, color = "Mean departure delay"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Year, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean delays by scheduled departure hour (2004-2008)",
    x = "Scheduled departure hour",
    y = "Minutes",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2a_hour_r
```

```{r save_hourly_2a}
ggsave("part2_r_2a_hourly_delay.png", plot = p2a_hour_r, width = 8, height = 14, dpi = 300)
```

```{r plot_day_2a}
delay_summary_day$day_name <- factor(
  delay_summary_day$day_name,
  levels = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
)

p2a_day_r <- ggplot(delay_summary_day, aes(x = day_name, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_arr_delay, color = "Mean arrival delay"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_arr_delay, color = "Mean arrival delay"), size = 1.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_dep_delay, color = "Mean departure delay"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_dep_delay, color = "Mean departure delay"), size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Year, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean delays by day of week (2004-2008)",
    x = "Day of week",
    y = "Minutes",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2a_day_r
```

```{r save_day_2a}
ggsave("part2_r_2a_day_delay.png", plot = p2a_day_r, width = 8, height = 14, dpi = 300)
```

```{r plot_2b_trend_combined}
p2b_trend_r <- ggplot(age_delay_summary_filtered,
                      aes(x = PlaneAge, y = mean_total_delay, color = factor(Year))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = "Plane age vs mean total delay by year",
    x = "Plane age",
    y = "Mean total delay (minutes)",

  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2b_trend_r
```

```{r save_2b_trend_combined}

```

```{r plot_2b_overlay}
corr_labels <- age_delay_summary_filtered %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(corr = cor(PlaneAge, mean_total_delay), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Year, " (r=", sprintf("%.2f", corr), ")"))

age_delay_overlay <- age_delay_summary_filtered %>%
  left_join(corr_labels %>% select(Year, label), by = "Year")

p2b_overlay_r <- ggplot(age_delay_overlay,
                        aes(x = PlaneAge, y = mean_total_delay, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = "Plane age vs mean total delay by year",
    x = "Plane age",
    y = "Mean total delay (minutes)",
    color = "Year & correlation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2b_overlay_r
```

```{r save_2b_overlay}
ggsave("part2_r_2b_age_regression_overlay.png", plot = p2b_overlay_r, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## Part 2(c)

```{r load_2c}
coef_all_years <- read_csv("data/coef_all_years_2004_2008.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
model_summary <- read_csv("data/model_summary_2004_2008.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
roc_summary <- read_csv("data/roc_summary_2004_2008.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
roc_points <- read_csv("data/roc_points_2004_2008.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

coef_all_years
model_summary
roc_summary
```

```{r class_balance_2c}
balance_plot_df <- model_summary %>%
  select(year, n_diverted_fit, n_not_diverted_fit) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_diverted_fit, n_not_diverted_fit),
    names_to = "class",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(class = recode(
    class,
    n_diverted_fit = "Diverted",
    n_not_diverted_fit = "Not diverted"
  ))

p2c_balance_r <- ggplot(balance_plot_df, aes(x = factor(year), y = count, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Sampled class balance used for yearly logistic regression",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of flights",
    fill = "Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2c_balance_r
```

```{r save_class_balance_2c}
ggsave("part2_r_2c_class_balance.png", plot = p2c_balance_r, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r coefficients_heatmap_2c}
top_features <- coef_all_years %>%
  mutate(abs_coef = abs(coefficient)) %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  summarise(mean_abs_coef = mean(abs_coef), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_coef)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 12) %>%
  pull(feature)

coef_heatmap_df <- coef_all_years %>%
  filter(feature %in% top_features)

p2c_heatmap_r <- ggplot(coef_heatmap_df, aes(x = factor(year), y = reorder(feature, coefficient), fill = coefficient)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", coefficient)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Top logistic regression coefficients across years",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Feature",
    fill = "Coefficient"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2c_heatmap_r
```

```{r save_coefficients_heatmap_2c}
ggsave("part2_r_2c_coefficients_heatmap.png", plot = p2c_heatmap_r, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r roc_curve_2c}
p2c_roc_r <- ggplot(roc_points, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = factor(year))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "ROC curves for yearly logistic regression models",
    x = "False Positive Rate",
    y = "True Positive Rate",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2c_roc_r
```

```{r save_roc_curve_2c}
ggsave("part2_r_2c_roc_curves.png", plot = p2c_roc_r, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
